pages.text: This is a pack built around movement, combat, magic, and machines — all at once.$(br2)$(bold)Early:$() Iron first. Craft a Hookshot (Iron Hook) immediately — it changes how the world feels to move through. Parkour is available from spawn: vaults, wall-jumps, slides. No unlock required.

$(bold)Mid:$() Start learning Epic Fight's battle mode and commit to a direction in the skill tree. Explore biomes for Mowzie's Mobs boss structures — fluid animations, unique AI, and abilities worth claiming. Get a Create water wheel running and build from there. Pick a spell school.$(br2)$(bold)Late:$() Hunt the Bosses' Rise encounters for top-tier armor. Wire your Create network into electricity via Create: New Age. Go deep on the skill tree.

$(bold)Recipe browsers:$() EMI is your main tool (left panel in inventory). JEI is also loaded for Create addon compatibility but its panel is hidden — use EMI for everything.$(br2)$(bold)Read the Controls page first.$() Several keys have been remapped from vanilla defaults and there are bindings worth knowing before you start.
